pages.title: False Vacuum
pages.text: Space in a higher-energy state than it should be, metastable and fragile. Contained, it looks like perfectly clear liquid, but the energy it stores is the energy of an entire universe waiting to tunnel down. I handle it gently.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Running a False Vacuum Membrane through the Bose-Einstein Condenser with superfluid helium, I found the condensate stabilised the metastable state long enough to bottle it. Coleman would not approve.
